businessSummary.name: North Ridge Workshop Planning
businessSummary.idea: Provide remote and local planning packages that help homeowners and small shops organize garages, work areas, tools, projects, and simple workflows before they spend money or start moving equipment.
customers: small repair shops with poor workflow
property owners planning a workshop project
businessSummary.serviceArea: Regional local service plus remote digital delivery in the United States
businessSummary.contactPreference: Mostly email and text with scheduled calls only when needed
businessSummary.revenueGoals: $6,000 per month with a mix of fixed packages and bounded recurring support
risks: and customers expecting licensed design work.
currentSystems: A basic website concept; sample layout files; email; cloud storage; and draft intake forms. No connected payment or accounting or social or customer-auth provider.
expansionIdeas: Add downloadable planning templates; shop workflow reviews; recurring project check-ins; and a white-label planning system for other service businesses.

businessSummary.primaryOutcome: A clear garage or workshop layout and phased action plan
